notes: Returns the top eligible task assigned to the agent persona (tag agent:<persona>, or assigned to an agent actor) inside the token's subtree: open, no open children or dependencies, not waiting on an unanswered ask, lease free or held by this session. Ranked by effective_priority (lower first; null means none set) then outline order. Takes a 90-minute lease for session; any call carrying the task with the same session renews it, and next_task re-issues it to that session. allowance is the task's own, else its nearest ancestor's, else null. spent rolls up record_usage on the task across sessions. hardDeadline is the nearest one on the task or above. Returns {"task": null} when nothing is eligible. defaults_allowed says whether the owner's Strategy policy allows proceeding on a seen, unanswered, reversible ask's default at this task's effective priority; until that policy is wired it is always false, so the agent always parks.
